messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Observed” means the day on which the holiday was actually taken off work when the statutory holiday fell on a weekend.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if applicable) | Typical long‑weekend span* |
|---------|-------------|---------------------------|----------------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Sunday Jan 1 | Monday Jan 2 | Sat Dec 31 – Mon Jan 2 |
| Family Day (Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Monday Feb 20 | — | Sat Feb 18 – Mon Feb 20 |
| Good Friday | Friday Apr 7 | — | Fri Apr 7 – Sun Apr 9 |
| Victoria Day | Monday May 22 | — | Sat May 20 – Mon May 22 |
| Canada Day | Saturday Jul 1 | Monday Jul 3 | Sat Jul 1 – Mon Jul 3 |
| Labour Day | Monday Sep 4 | — | Sat Sep 2 – Mon Sep 4 |
| Thanksgiving | Monday Oct 9 | — | Sat Oct 7 – Mon Oct 9 |
| Remembrance Day | Saturday Nov 11 | Monday Nov 13 | Sat Nov 11 – Mon Nov 13 |
| Christmas | Monday Dec 25 | — | Sat Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25 |
| Boxing Day | Tuesday Dec 26 | — | Sun Dec 24 – Tue Dec 26 |

\*Long‑weekend span shows the weekend days that flank the holiday. Some provinces observe additional “bridge” days (e.g., a Monday off when a holiday falls on a Tuesday), but the table above lists the core statutory holidays that create the most common long weekends across Canada.

Feel free to filter or expand this list by province if your app needs more granular data!
message.reasoning:
The user wants the list of long weekends for Canada in 2023. They want to fetch it. We have a tool "connectBluetooth" but that's irrelevant. There's no tool to fetch holidays. So we cannot use a tool. We should respond with the data. We can provide the list manually. Let's find the Canadian public holidays that create long weekends in 2023. In Canada, long weekends typically include New Year's Day (Jan 1), Family Day (Feb 20 in some provinces), Good Friday (April 7), Victoria Day (May 22), Canada Day (July 1), Labour Day (Sep 4), Thanksgiving (Oct 9), Remembrance Day (Nov 11), Christmas (Dec 25), Boxing Day (Dec 26). But long weekends depend on whether the holiday falls on a weekday and if the adjacent days are weekend or not. For example, if a holiday falls on a Monday, it's a long weekend. If it falls on a Tuesday, then the preceding Monday might be a day off if the province has a "bridge" holiday. But the question likely expects the standard long weekends: New Year's Day (if Jan 1 is Sunday, then observed on Monday Jan 2?), etc.

Let's list the long weekends in Canada for 2023:

- New Year's Day: Jan 1, 2023 (Sunday) – Observed on Monday Jan 2. Long weekend: Dec 31, 2022 (Saturday) to Jan 2, 2023 (Monday). But for 2023, the long weekend includes Jan 1-3? Actually, the holiday is observed on Jan 2, so the long weekend is Jan 1-3? Wait, if Jan 1 is Sunday, the holiday is observed on Monday Jan 2. So the long weekend is Dec 31 (Sat) - Jan 2 (Mon). But the user wants the list of long weekends for Canada in 2023. We can list them as dates.

Better to list the long weekends as the holiday date and the weekend days around it. Provide the holiday name and the weekend days.

List:

- New Year's Day: Jan 1 (Sunday) – Observed on Jan 2 (Monday). Long weekend: Dec 31, 2022 (Sat) – Jan 2, 2023 (Mon).
- Family Day (in Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario): Feb 20 (Monday). Long weekend: Feb 18-20 (Sat-Sun-Mon).
- Good Friday: Apr 7 (Friday). Long weekend: Apr 7-9 (Fri-Sun).
- Victoria Day: May 22 (Monday). Long weekend: May 20-22 (Sat-Mon).
- Canada Day: Jul 1 (Saturday). Observed on Jul 3 (Monday). Long weekend: Jul 1-3 (Sat-Mon).
- Labour Day: Sep 4 (Monday). Long weekend: Sep 2-4 (Sat-Mon).
- Thanksgiving: Oct 9 (Monday). Long weekend: Oct 7-9 (Sat-Mon).
- Remembrance Day: Nov 11 (Saturday). Observed on Nov 13 (Monday). Long weekend: Nov 11-13 (Sat-Mon).
- Christmas: Dec 25 (Monday). Long weekend: Dec 23-25 (Sat-Mon).
- Boxing Day: Dec 26 (Tuesday). Long weekend: Dec 24-26 (Sun-Tue) – but usually the long weekend is Dec 24-26.

But note that Boxing Day is a holiday only in some provinces. Also, the long weekend for Boxing Day may be considered as Dec 24-26.

Also, there are other holidays like St. Patrick's Day (not official). But we can list the major ones.

We should mention that the long weekends vary by province. Provide a table with holiday, date, observed date, long weekend days.

We can also mention that the user can filter by province.

Thus, we will provide the list. No tool needed.
